lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: On paper, it all looked right. The project impressed. The certificate scanned clean. The numbers lined up like a solved puzzle.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: But the foundation wasn’t there. You knew it. Maybe you paid for a shortcut; maybe you borrowed a voice that wasn’t yours. Success arrived anyway, thin and fragile.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The first time the work demanded what the documents promised, the ground shifted. The sand gave way. You realized you had built a future you didn’t know how to live in.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: People still congratulated you. That made it worse. Praise feels heavy when it doesn’t fit.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You won the moment. You lost the base.
